summary: Inkheart is a lightweight application designed for reading and managing PDF documents and e-books. It is packaged as a container image for straightforward deployment on your own infrastructure. The software provides a self-hosted interface for handling document collections.
goodFor: It suits homelab users looking for a minimal, containerised tool dedicated specifically to PDF and e-book consumption.
watchOut: Repository activity is minimal and the project lacks a health rating, so you may encounter unaddressed bugs or a lack of documentation for complex setups.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to mount a persistent volume for your document library and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
